V-05.note: Law-of-cosines reconstruction, the one real solve in this run. 67,130,193 are an arithmetic run of difference 63 with sqrt11 outside. 130 = 7^2+9^2 and 63 = 2*7*9*cos60. So the set is c^2 for a 7-9 triangle: 130 = forgot the cosine term, 193 = sign error (120 deg), 67 = key. Residual risk: if the stem gave 120 deg the key is sqrt193, so this is a content-grounded 50/50 between A and B, not a certainty. NOTE this pick deliberately contradicts my own M-E rule, which would have said 130 (sqrt130 = C... = D).
